leads.name: EcoDataCenter Smedjebacken
leads.quote: The campus has green light of an immediate 150MW
leads.note: New site distinct from P001/P003/P006. 150 MW denominator and connection maturity unresolved; early 2027 concerns construction subject to permits, not operations.

leads.name: EcoDataCenter Norrsundet
leads.quote: etablering av anläggning för datacentertjänster i Norrsundet, Gävle kommun.
leads.note: New consultation lead, response deadline 11 October 2026. No usable MW or commissioning date retrieved. Distinct from Brookfield Gävle; verify parcels and connection before promotion.

leads.name: Google Torsboda
leads.quote: Kommunfullmäktiges beslut att sälja Torsboda Industrial Park har överklagats.
leads.note: Distinct from P015 Horndal. Conditional company/land transfer subject to appeal; no scoped capacity or operational date approved.

leads.name: Green Mountain SVG-Undheim
leads.quote:
total IT capacity of 80 MW.
Construction is currently underway, with full completion scheduled for 2028.
leads.note: IDENTITY HOLD: P023 combines Kalberg/Undheim. Resolve P023 and separate sites before creating a new master project. Source distinguishes 80 MW IT and 100 MW site capacity; neither is additive to the other.

leads.name: EdgeConneX Molandsmoen
leads.quote: 140 MW er tildelt, medan 225 MW ventar på tildeling gjennom kapasitetskø.
leads.note: New site. 140 MW allocated connection and 225 MW queued are different states; 365 MW must not become installed IT. Verify scoped phases and grid authority record.

leads.name: BW Velora Frier Vest
leads.quote: Prosjektet planlegges med en kapasitet på rundt 250 megawatt
leads.note: New development agreement. Approximately 250 MW has no explicit IT/facility denominator in the announcement. Financing, phases and commissioning remain unresolved.

leads.name: Nscale Narvik / Kvandal
leads.quote: the 230 MW Nscale Narvik campus will add more than 30,000
leads.note: New to current inventory; alias Stargate Norway. Updated source identifies Microsoft deployment in 2027 and Nscale management. Do not count customer GPUs as a second campus or assume all 230 MW starts in 2027. Reconcile original 230+290 ambition by phase.

leads.name: atNorth FIN05 Salo
leads.quote: Power for the first phase, planned at 75 MW, is secured
leads.note: Distinct from FIN01/02/04. First-phase 75 MW power and wider path to 230 MW are not automatically IT or installed load. No full commissioning year approved.

leads.name: Microsoft GigaVaasa
leads.quote: Vi är för närvarande i färd med att ansöka om bygglov hos Mustasaari kommun och staden Vasa.
leads.note: New site straddles municipalities; resolve project/site geographic representation. July site preparation is separate from full datacenter construction. No MW or operational year approved.

leads.name: Google Kajaani
leads.quote: in Hamina, Kajaani, Muhos and Vaala.
leads.note: New Google site, distinct from CSC/Borealis in Kajaani. 94 MW battery is not data-center load. LVV 6 October calls for significant site preparation to stop pending EIA; not a cancellation. No capacity approved.

leads.name: Google Muhos
leads.quote: in Hamina, Kajaani, Muhos and Vaala.
leads.note: New site. LVV 6 October calls for significant site preparation to stop pending EIA; not a cancellation. Investment period 2027–2028 is not full commissioning. No capacity approved.

leads.name: Google Vaala
leads.quote: in Hamina, Kajaani, Muhos and Vaala.
leads.note: New site. Do not extrapolate the Kajaani/Muhos preparation restriction to Vaala. Portfolio investment and energy procurement are not site MW.

leads.name: Hyperco Data Systems Hiivuri west
leads.quote: Hyperco Fin Holdco 1 Oy:n rakenteilla olevan datakeskuksen länsipuolelle.
leads.note: IDENTITY HOLD: neighbouring development, distinct from P030/Blackhawk. First resolve C042's incorrect 100 MW IT and 130 MW electrical attribution. No duplicate 100 MW added.

leads.name: Borealis Otanmäki
leads.note: New planning reservation in Otanmäki; distinguish from P025 existing Renforsin Ranta campus. Land reservation alone does not establish a financed datacenter or capacity.

leads.name: Nebius Lappeenranta
leads.quote: Lappeenranta with capacity of up to 310 MW.
leads.note: Distinct from P034 Mäntsälä and P035 XTX Kajaani, despite repeated 310 MW number. 2027 concerns first capacity. Denominator, installed baseline and full envelope date need scoped review.
